Online Crime Principle 2: Crime is the violation of a law, a duty, or a moral principle (p. 7).
Online Crime Principle 3: Those arrested by law enforcement officers for committing crimesface prosecution and punishment (p. 7).
Online Crime Principle 4: In this pamphlet, you willlearn about the different types of crimes and steps that you, andyour family and neighbors, can take to help prevent (p. 7).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Online Crime): In addition to being possible victims of crime, your family and other citizens carry the financial burden of criminal acts (p. 7).
Step 2 (Online Crime): Citizens must pay, usually through higher taxes, for additionallaw enforcement officers, increased court costs, and moreprisons and jails (p. 7).
